title: Signature: Sensitivity inheritance
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): derived data inherits the maximum sensitivity of its sources. A report built from a secret dataset is secret, even if the report itself looks innocent. Inheritance is tracked through the lineage graph so sensitivity can never be laundered away by transformation. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers derived data inheriting max source sensitivity.

title: Signature: Redaction preview
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): before protection is applied, reviewers see a preview showing exactly what each label would redact. Previews prevent over-redaction that destroys utility and under-redaction that leaks data. The preview is itself access-controlled. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers showing exactly what each label redacts.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: "Amy (555-0100)", 2: "Amy ssn 123-45-6789", 3: "Amy amy@x.com ssn 123-45-6789"}
import re
text = CFG[LEVEL]
preview = re.sub(r"\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}", "[SSN]", re.sub(r"[\w.]+@[\w.]+", "[EMAIL]", re.sub(r"\d{3}-\d{4}", "[PHONE]", text)))
print("original:", text, "| preview:", preview)
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Cross-language sensitivity
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): sensitivity patterns are adapted per language and script instead of assuming English. Identifier formats, honorifics, and address structures differ globally; the classifier loads locale packs so protection quality does not depend on the language of the data. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers locale packs for identifier formats.
